text:
Night above the two with moon full,

I me puse to to cry and you reías.

Your desdén was a dios, the quejas mías

momentos and doves in chain.


Night below the two. Cristal of sorrow,

llorabas you for hondas lejanías.

My pain was a grupo of agonías

over your débil heart of sand.


The dawn us unió over the cama,

the bocas puestas over the chorro helado

of a blood without fin that itself derrama.


And the sun entró for the balcón closed

and the coral of the life abrió your branch

over my heart amortajado.

translation.title: Night above the two with moon full...
